info.name: Girder REST API (Emory Digital Slide Archive) annotation assetstore API

params.name: limit
params.description: Result set size limit.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset into result set.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort the result set by.

params.name: sortdir
params.description: Sort order: 1 for ascending, -1 for descending.

params.name: name
params.description: Unique name for the assetstore.

params.name: type
params.description: Type of the assetstore.

params.name: root
params.description: Root path on disk (for filesystem type).

params.name: perms
params.description: File creation permissions (for filesystem type).

params.name: db
params.description: Database name (for GridFS type)

params.name: mongohost
params.description: Mongo host URI (for GridFS type)

params.name: replicaset
params.description: Replica set name (for GridFS type)

params.name: bucket
params.description: The S3 bucket to store data in (for S3 type).

params.name: prefix
params.description: Optional path prefix within the bucket under which files will be stored (for S3 type).

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: The AWS access key ID to use for authentication (for S3 type).

params.name: secret
params.description: The AWS secret key to use for authentication (for S3 type).

params.name: service
params.description: The S3 service host (for S3 type).  Default is s3.amazonaws.com.  This can be used to specify a protocol and port as well using the form [http[s]://](host domain)[:(port)]. Do not include the bucket name here.

params.name: readOnly
params.description: If this assetstore is read-only, set this to true.

params.name: region
params.description: The AWS region to which the S3 bucket belongs.

params.name: inferCredentials
params.description: The credentials for connecting to S3 will be inferred by Boto rather than explicitly passed. Inferring credentials will ignore accessKeyId and secret.

params.name: serverSideEncryption
params.description: Whether to use S3 SSE to encrypt the objects uploaded to this bucket (for S3 type).

params.name: allowS3AcceleratedTransfer
params.description: Whether to allow clients to requests a data transfer using S3 transfer acceleration.

params.name: url
params.description: The base URL for the DICOMweb server (for DICOMweb)

params.name: qido_prefix
params.description: The QIDO URL prefix for the server, if needed (for DICOMweb)

params.name: wado_prefix
params.description: The WADO URL prefix for the server, if needed (for DICOMweb)

params.name: auth_type
params.description: The authentication type required for the server, if needed (for DICOMweb)

params.name: auth_token
params.description: Token for authentication if needed (for DICOMweb)

items.docs: You must be an administrator to call this.

info.name: Import existing data into an assetstore.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the document.

params.name: importPath
params.description: Root path within the underlying storage system to import.

params.name: destinationId
params.description: ID of a folder, collection, or user in Girder under which the data will be imported.

params.name: destinationType
params.description: Type of the destination resource.

params.name: progress
params.description: Whether to record progress on the import.

params.name: leafFoldersAsItems
params.description: Whether folders containing only files should be imported as items.

params.name: fileIncludeRegex
params.description: If set, only filenames matching this regular expression will be imported.

params.name: fileExcludeRegex
params.description: If set, only filenames that do not match this regular expression will be imported. If a file matches both the include and exclude regex, it will be excluded.

params.name: excludeExisting
params.description: If true, then a file with an import path that is already in the system is not imported, even if it is not in the destination hierarchy.

items.docs: This does not move or copy the existing data, it just creates references to it in the Girder data hierarchy. Deleting those references will not delete the underlying data. This operation is currently only supported for S3 assetstores.
